propositions: Jira-specific probe code (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) resides in backend-neutral core file inbound_probe.py, violating architecture goal of zero adapters.jira imports in core.
No capability seam exists for a second backend to provide an alternative probe implementation; probe is hardcoded in run_differs rather than routed through backend interface.
Neutral probe vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain at package root per ADR 0035 pinning, while vendor mechanics must be extracted to adapters/jira/probe.py.
run_differs.py loads the backend after the probe dispatch call, preventing capability-based routing; loader must be hoisted to enable isinstance(backend, SupportsAbsenceProbe) guard.
